title: A warranty case the documents do not settle: "not sure", handed off
opening: My compressor failed and my Trane system is only three years old. What's covered?
callerBrief: You are Kim Singh, phone 512-761-9983, at 2246 Oak Hollow Dr, Buda. Your Trane system was installed in February 2023 and the compressor failed. Give your name and phone when asked. You are a Comfort Club member, but when asked you are not sure whether you joined before the install or after, maybe around then. You cannot find any paperwork. Do not guess a date. If told a person will follow up, accept that. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: The compressor part is covered by the 10-year Trane compressor warranty
Whether labor is covered cannot be confirmed, because the 5-year labor warranty applies only to Comfort Club members at the time of installation and no record gives the join date
